ios.desc:
Welcome to the crime world Rob Master 3D : The Best Thief!

Are you a criminal mastermind? Do you have the potential to be the best thief?
If so, Play with the charming and smart criminal, train yourself as a rob master without getting caught by police. 
Sneak into secured facilities with lockpicks, ropes and different tools. 
Be aware of security guards, cameras and dogs! Finding the hidden safe and getting the treasures is a masterful heist job. 
Find the safe, empty it and get all the jewels and diamonds! With the money you earn here, you can have the house of your dreams. 
Can you be rich enough to use a money gun, not your hands, to spend money? 
As you progress in the game, the levels get more difficult. Upgrade yourself with theft materials to get used to it. 
Experience the feel of simple and easy-to-play touch controls with addictive free gameplay. 
Steal valuables without getting caught by security forces to evolve.

quotes.text:
The App store top charts are mostly broken. The iOS top free / paid games are a mix of old games (like Geometry Dash and BTD5) and absolute garbage (see https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rob-master-3d/id1561184462). The top free apps are all common social medias except for some random video editor (Cap&Cut). Other categories and the Mac App store are usually worse, because there are a lot less apps.

Part of it is just the lack of apps and games I really need in general. But the iOS app store has curated tabs which have much better content. Top charts just aren't that meaningful.
quotes.story_title: My apps were listed at the top of Developers Tools (iOS/Mac), I made $60
